mostWorthwhile.text: The practice handoff was most worthwhile: Sal and Miro checked the fault, restored the panel and each demonstrated the work using their own access.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to combine the fault-located panel with the cupboard was least worthwhile; I guessed at a handoff before replacing the faulty module. The feedback recovered the step automatically.

surprise.text: The powered lamp alongside a missing signal was a useful reminder that equipment can have power while its reporting path has failed.

arbitrary.text: The bell's need to connect to the spare repeater rather than directly to the neighbor link was not clear to me beforehand, though the matched fault contact explained it afterward.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the shared network and its new operators fare, especially after the practical handoff and installed alarm test.
